edits.before: - Xerath Shocking Orb (Stun): matchup-defining — His only CC — dodge the orb and his artillery never converts into a kill. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E Assassin's Path like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Xerath Shocking Orb (Stun): matchup-defining — 13s at rank 1, 11s max, and it is his only CC. Dodge or bait it and his artillery never converts. - Eye of Destruction is 14s early: two whiffs is a whole all-in window. - Your R goes to kill windows only.

edits.before: W on the contact, Q the gap, auto for the bleed, walk through the return — three stacks of rent he paid for one trade.
edits.after: When he steps up to Arcanopulse, W him through the wave, Q the gap, auto the third stack — his paper health folds to it.

edits.before: Q-leaping into a held CC for style — Talon without the gap-closer is a roamer stuck in traffic.
edits.after: An uncrashed wave lets Xerath free-farm from 1000 range and poke your tower — crash first so he loses either CS or plates.

edits.before: Level 6 is Talon's: Bladeflurry deletes him the instant you close the gap.
edits.after: Level 6 is Talon's: Shadow Assault deletes him the moment you close the gap.
